topic: E-130J TACAMO FY2026-to-FY2027 published funding and schedule state
public_statement: The June 2025 FY2026 BA5 schedule placed PDR, EMD aircraft builds, mission-system integration, SDTA build, CSIL Test, Integrated Test 1, and tester training primarily within FY2026, with FY2026 TACAMO RDT&E requested at $1,243.978 million.
internal_content: The April 2026 FY2027 BA5 submission explicitly says the schedule was updated to the current program schedule, records FY2026 funding at $1,043.978 million after a $200 million Congressional Directed Reduction, moves multiple build/integration/test windows into FY2027-2031, and requests $1,662.723 million in FY2027 including purchase of three SDTA C-130J-30 aircraft.
notes: This comparison establishes a published program-state revision, not milestone completion or failure. The later book does not itself provide PDR minutes, build-completion records, test results, delivery/acceptance records, or readiness evidence.
